proposal.description: The drift-headroom MSB of the period counter is treated as internal only and is dropped from the prev_period export, so the exported period is taken modulo 2^(CNT_W-1).
proposal.reason: When pwm_sync stalls and the counter saturates, the next rising edge exports 127 instead of the all-ones out-of-range marker 255. Any slow period of 128 or more clocks also reads short, which looks like a higher switching frequency.

proposal.description: The saturation hold is applied only to a stall with pwm_sync held low (a dead modulator taken to mean PWM low). The stalled-high case named in the comment is left out, so the counter wraps.
proposal.reason: If pwm_sync stays high for more than 255 clocks, period_counter wraps through 0. The fall then captures a small duty_count and the next rise exports a short prev_period instead of all-ones.

after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
proposal.description: The start-of-cycle strobe pwm_rise is registered, unlike pwm_fall, so the period counter is restarted one clock after the rising edge while the duty snapshot still uses the combinational fall.
proposal.reason: In steady switching, duty_count reads one less than the HS high time measured from the same counter run, so it no longer matches prev_period. With a one-clock HS pulse, the delayed rise and the fall land on the same clock, the rise wins, and duty_count is not updated.
